brands.name: Boomerang Boards
brands.short_description: Handmade surfboards by San Diego shaper John Hromin, with over 30 years of shaping experience.

models.name: Fuze - recycled
models.description: Fuze model made from recyclable foam blank cut offs.

models.name: Majic Fish Egg
models.description: Four Fin with channel through quad fins, one of the most versatile boards, EPS and epoxy gives it a short board feel with a longer rail line and tons of speed. This board is just too much fun!

models.name: Jelly Fish
models.description: Short board for small waves. The Jelly Fish is the icon of the Boomerang brand and considered an entry model for every surfer wanting to start out riding a hand-shaped board. Developed in 1994, the ‘Jelly Fish’ has been developed with the ‘everyday surfer’ in mind. Tackle anything from small performance surfing to expert shredding. Nicely blended outline with a double-wing swallowtail.
